gloss: to be orderly; to be neat and organized

definitions.gloss: to be orderly; to be well-organized; to be neat and tidy
definitions.explanation: Describes a state where things are arranged in proper order, neatly and systematically. Used for physical spaces, processes, arguments, and behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{整然|せいぜん}として⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The room is neat and orderly.

examples.japanese: {整然|せいぜん}とした⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{整然|せいぜん}→整然：09210_seizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Even during the disaster, people lined up in an orderly manner.

notes:
Describes a state of order and organization. Most commonly used in the adverbial form ⟦{整然|せいぜん}→整然：09210_seizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or as the modifier {整然|せいぜん}とした. Conveys a sense of neatness, systematic arrangement, and discipline.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{整然|せいぜん}→整然：09210_seizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in an orderly way
- {整然|せいぜん}とした⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a tidy room
- {整然|せいぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: composed, orderly behavior
- ⟦{整然|せいぜん}→整然：09210_seizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed in an orderly fashion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雑然|ざつぜん}→雑然：09236_zatsuzen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be cluttered, messy, in disorder — the direct antonym
- ⟦きちんとする→きちんとする：25802_kichintosuru⟧: to be tidy, proper — more casual and everyday; covers both physical tidiness and behavioral correctness
- ⟦{秩序|ちつじょ}{正|ただ}しい→秩序正しい：22040_chitsujotadashii⟧: orderly, disciplined — emphasizes following rules and social order
- ⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧: well-arranged, in order — describes the result of organizing
